name: Meteoric-Minaret
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in tectonic rift valleys. Travelers navigate by massive canyon systems and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
